preprocessing: NFKC normalization, HTML entity/tag/script/style removal, whitespace normalization; no test-fitted transformations
publisher_leakage_analysis: Unavailable: original files have no authenticated publisher/source column. Reuters-style text cues are not treated as publisher IDs.

language_detection.method: Seeded sample; heuristic language detection, not a language benchmark

license_status: Original repository sample provenance/redistribution terms remain unverified. Raw article content is not redistributed.

semantic_diagnostic.note: This is a sampled diagnostic, not full-corpus semantic deduplication. Similarity clusters can include different articles about the same event.
